context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about a fraud case
purpose: Teach: 犯行/孤立/敗北/臓器/発症/投与/危惧/及ぼし

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者の多くは、孤立した高齢者です。
lines.en: Most of the victims are isolated elderly people.
lines.style: Measured, factual opening. Professional register — Officer Takeda delivering information clearly without emotional charge. Steady eye contact. The cadence of someone presenting documented cases.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 犯行手口、敗北宣言を取らせるパターンですね。
lines.en: So the pattern is forcing them into making some kind of confession or admission of defeat.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Ren working through the logic aloud — not quite a question, more checking his understanding. Quiet intensity. The speech of someone connecting dots.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。心身に深刻な影響を及ぼし、健康への危惧もあります。
lines.en: Yes. It causes serious damage — both psychological and physical. We're also concerned about the health complications that follow.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Takeda confirming with added weight. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on 「深刻」—this is the core issue. Professional concern beneath the official tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過去には、薬の不正投与で発症した方も。
lines.en: There have been cases in the past where victims developed symptoms after being given medication without their knowledge.
lines.style: Ren pressing deeper, voice quieter. Academic precision mixed with something harder underneath — this matters to him. No rush. The deliberate pace of someone who has thought about this before speaking.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 臓器が弱った高齢者、特に守らねば。
lines.en: Elderly patients with compromised organs especially — they're the ones we have to protect.
lines.style: Firmer. Takeda's conviction surfaces. Not harsh, but the protective urgency beneath protocol. A single steady beat of emphasis. The voice of someone for whom this is not abstract.
